title: Rockies Fall/Spring Premium Tour from Vancouver
includes: Experienced, friendly, and fun tour guide
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the serene beauty of the Canadian Rockies during the calmer spring and fall seasons. This 5-day tour includes two nights in Banff, where you'll enjoy scenic views from the Banff Gondola, soak in Radium Hot Springs, and explore the stunning nature trails of Marble Canyon. Experience seasonal highlights like the vibrant tulip festival in spring and the spectacular sockeye salmon run in the fall. Ideal for nature lovers and those seeking tranquility, this tour combines guided adventures with free time to relax and explore at your pace.

- Experience the beauty of the Rockies with fewer crowds
- Enjoy 2 nights’ accommodation in Banff
- Relax in the natural waters of Radium Hot Springs after outdoor exploration
- Daily breakfast included; enjoy free time for lunch and dinner
